- Invoice format: Do you require a specific invoice schema (PDF, XML, CSV, EDI)? Any PO number format constraints we should know about?
- Tax/VAT: Please confirm ACME tax/VAT ID and whether VAT needs to be shown line-by-line.
- Billing address & contact: Best billing address and AP contact for sending invoices and for PO routing.

From: Lena Morris <lena.morris@acme-corp.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: commercial path & invoice needs (post-demo)

Hi Priyom — great demo, thanks. Answers below (cc'd AP and Marcus for visibility):

- Commercial path: For this pilot the preferred route is a PO from the central procurement team (Finance will issue a PO).
- Net terms: Our standard is Net 45 for new vendors; Net 30 can be approved for existing preferred vendors only. Anything beyond Net 45 will need CFO sign-off (I've looped Marcus).
- Invoice format: PDF is fine. We can accept an XML/CSV extract for bulk uploads but AP prefers a human-readable PDF attached to the PO number. No EDI for pilots.
- PO/# format: PO numbers start with ACME- and are eight digits (e.g., ACME-01234567). Please include PO on the invoice header and file name.
- Tax/VAT: ACME is VAT-registered in the US/UK; please include our VAT ID on invoices. I’ve attached our AP invoice requirements PDF for reference (fields, remittance, and GL code guidance).
- Billing address & contact:
  Billing address: ACME Corporation, 210 Market St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105
  AP contact: accounts-payable@acme-corp.com (use this for invoice submission).

We can accept invoices via email to accounts-payable@acme-corp.com or via our vendor portal (details in the attached PDF).

Attached: acme_invoice_requirements.pdf

Let me know if you need anything else — happy to set a 15-min call with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Lena
